name: CoreAdminPanel
intent: A full app-shell admin template: CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar around three administration surfaces selected from the sidebar — Projects (a projects DataTable), Permissions (role cards + a role×permission matrix), and Users (a users DataTable with bulk role/deactivate actions).
when: An admin/settings area that owns its own app shell (sidebar + top bar), not just a content region
Managing organization-level entities: projects, roles/permissions, and users
A multi-section admin surface where the left nav switches the main content
whenNot: A single content page rendered inside an existing app shell -> use a content-only template
A project analytics dashboard -> use Analytics Overview / Project Overview
A CRUD form for one entity -> use a Dialog launched from a list

chooseOver.component: Assembling CoreAppSidebar + CoreAppTopBar + tables by hand per admin section
chooseOver.because: Admin Panel owns the shell, the sidebar-driven section switching, and the Projects/Permissions/Users surfaces.

allowedPlacement: route-level admin / settings surface that owns the full window
